subject: Post-call: IAM evidence & next steps (SSO/SAML, SCIM, RBAC)
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>

Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>

Subject: Post-call: IAM evidence & next steps (SSO/SAML, SCIM, RBAC)

Thanks for taking the call earlier, Jake 
good to meet you and Priya. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have a single source of truth for your security team: 

Summary of ask:
- Stellar Health needs proof points for identity & access controls as part of your vendor security questionnaire (SOC 2 is in progress; primary focus is IAM evidence).
- Specific items requested: SSO/SAML metadata and instructions, SCIM provisioning details, RBAC/admin controls and audit trails.

What Redwood will provide (next 48 hours):
1) SAML metadata export and step-by-step SSO setup guide for Azure AD / Okta (attachment).
2) SCIM API overview and sample provisioning payloads (attachment).
3) RBAC matrix showing default roles, admin privileges, and self-service flows + how to request elevated access.
4) Pointer to audit log retention policy and how to pull admin activity logs (we can provide exported examples under NDA).

Questions / clarifications needed from Stellar Health:
- Which IdP(s) do you plan to use (Okta, AzureAD, OneLogin)?
- Do you want SCIM provisioning to be enabled at launch or handled manually by your IT team?
- Any strict retention periods we should be aware of for audit artifacts?

Next steps:
- I will drop the artifacts attached to this thread. Aditya (CC) will own any follow-up technical questions on SCIM and SAML. Neha will coordinate any compliance-related redlines.
- If these look good, we can move to sign an NDA (if needed) and provide exported audit samples.

Thanks 
looking forward to moving this forward.

Best,

Marissa Cole

marissa_cole@redwood.ai
(415) 555-0198

Date: Tue, 05 Aug 2026 16:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call: IAM evidence & next steps (SSO/SAML, SCIM, RBAC)

Thanks Marissa 
this is exactly what we need. Quick answers to your clarifying Qs:
- IdP: We'll be using Okta primarily, but may want AzureAD in a later phase.
- SCIM: We prefer SCIM provisioning enabled at launch if Redwood supports group-level mappings.
- Retention: Standard: 12 months for admin activity logs; some scoped audit trails (access to PHI-related admin actions) need 36 months 
we'll mark those fields on the questionnaire.

We do have a standard vendor security questionnaire. I'll start that and share it with security@stellar-health.com. For now, could you send the SAML metadata and an Okta-focused SSO setup snippet? Priya and our security team may follow up with more detailed evidence requests (e.g., sample audit exports).

Also, can you tell us whether Redwood supports SCIM claims mapping for custom groups and whether role changes via SCIM are logged in audit events?

Appreciate the quick turnaround.

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Jake Morris <jmorris@stellar-health.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>

Subject: Re: Post-call: IAM evidence & next steps (SSO/SAML, SCIM, RBAC)

Jake 
thanks for the quick reply and the retention detail; noted. Per your ask I've attached the Okta-focused snippets and metadata. Summary answers inline below and in the attached docs: 

- SAML/SSO: attached redwood_saml_metadata.xml + step-by-step Okta config in redwood_sso_setup_guide.pdf. The metadata contains ACS and EntityID you can paste into Okta. SLO is supported but optional.

- SCIM provisioning: Redwood supports SCIM 2.0 with group-level mappings. You can map Okta groups to Redwood roles. See redwood_scim_api_overview.pdf for endpoints and a sample payload.

- RBAC & audit logging: Role changes via SCIM are logged as admin events and surface in our audit logs. I've attached rbac_matrix.csv that shows default roles (Viewer, Editor, Admin), which permissions are included, and which events are recorded.

- Audit exports: We can provide a redacted export of admin activity (example) under an NDA. If you'd like, Neha can coordinate a limited export (12 months / 36 months scoped) and walk through the fields.

Next actions proposed:
1) Jake/Priya: review attached artifacts and confirm any follow-up evidence (e.g., sample audit export, architecture diagrams) you need for the questionnaire.
2) If an NDA is required to receive logs, we'll circulate a one-way NDA (DocuSign link below) 
sign and we'll deliver the export.
3) Aditya: I'll hand off any deep technical SCIM mapping questions to you.

Hey Jake 
quick technical note on SCIM group-to-role mappings:
- We support mapping Okta groups to Redwood roles (including custom roles). The SCIM /Groups endpoint can be used for group provisioning; when a user is added/removed from a mapped group, we emit an admin_event of type GROUP_MEMBERSHIP_CHANGED.
- Role assignment events are logged and include timestamp, actor (service account or admin user), and the before/after role. These are available via our audit API (read-only).

If you want, I can schedule a 30-minute walk-through with your Okta admin to go over the payloads and test provisioning. Let me know a couple windows that work for your team.

Thanks,
Aditya Rao
Solutions Architect, Redwood Inference
aditya_rao@redwood.ai

(Attachment: example_scim_payload.json)
